Later final changes on the same row explain the current differences from the 2019 resolution text: FHIR-37915/2632a1bef7 added Device and Endpoint, and FHIR-40580/b332a03008 corrected HealthCareService to HealthcareService. The linked ServiceRequest-specific FHIR-20932 was later resolved no-change and does not undo the Request pattern addition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already satisfies the seed issue and the broader current target list reflects later accepted changes.
